description.text: Teaching Objects: The Foreigners, overseas Chinese who are not Chinese-native speakers and interested in Chinese language and Chinese culture. Teaching Goal: To learn Chinese language and Chinese traditional culture; to improve the communication ability in Chinese; to promote the understanding between different cultures. Learning Time: to learn at any time for 3-6 weeks and 22 hours of school learning each week. The length of schooling can also be negotiated according to specific conditions. Teaching Content: According to the students' Chinese language level and their specific requirements, there are primary, secondary and advanced courses. The main courses include: Integrated Chinese, Chinese Listening, Spoken-Chinese, Chinese Reading, Chinese Culture and HSK Strengthen Course. Teaching Principle: Focus on the intercommunication, practice, pertinence and interests in the teaching course. Teaching Method: The courses are combined with field visit, investigation, and sightseeing.

duration.text: The Two-week Chinese Language Training Program at Hebei Finance University is a 0 N/A long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 194 USD/In total ￥ 1400 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3. Resume Written in Chinese or in English

requirements.text: There is no restriction on the applicant's Chinese language skill, age and the applicants should be in good condition.
